book.name: Qayeeng yeip yaing
book.title: Kilisi talex qayeeng xupekeing yeip yaing wou Yoan

content: Qayeeng ne la wou kongrikesin wei toundei eivek Sadis o
Woyom tambiy tiyon neil no, “Wa byex qayeeng tine na wou angela wei kongrikesin wei toundei eivek beyeeng Sadis o.
Inye qayeeng beimambei wei moux wei di zeim laweeng lim yuw wei Anutu yo me betum lim yuw. A woulek wa xe xuk neing. Wang wo leim en ingwei wang toundei mapieing o, ek ma, wang mey o.
Wa qandi lek veil yeipeing! Me na byexaxoun lulul vati wei nanghei toundei yon wei embim a mey yo, en a se xei wa xe xuk neing ti la vup wou a xe Anutu manghalus.

Wang bounaleim en vati wei wang ngo me ghe qou myaxeeng, wa zeimaxoun e bo nikanzek. Wa betiwou me pekwi xow. Ek wangwei wa se qandi lek veil yeipeing, on tyek a nak wou wang nambei panaxana ti, me tyek wa seng boulek bouk vati wei tyek a nak wou wang o.
Ekom wa xe xel nuyuw ka eno toundei eivek Sadis wei xel se wo xel xe teimb wo nilaxes. Xel xe kwa yon nimza teyei lek ingwei xel vunek en teimb teleing me na vaxend is ay.

Wangwei tambiy ti ghoklek nimaying, tyek bunek en teimb teleing nambei xel. On tyek a se teyeimbei davu e lei veil qapiya wei mapieing o, qe tyek a neil e lei teyei wou mang manghalus me e xe xel angela.
Woyom tambiy tiwei nenyalis toundei lek e yo, wong e ngo vati wei Laweeng Vambuing di neil wou xel kongrikesin o.”
Qayeeng ne la wou kongrikesin wei toundei eivek Piladelpia yo
Woyom tambiy tiyon neil no, “Wa byex qayeeng tine na wou angela wei toundei eivek kongrikesin wei Piladelpia yo.

Inye qayeeng beimambei wei e wei vambuing o me zonghek o, wei mi zeim ki wei Dawit o. Vati wei e tax o, xelti se teyeimbei qepei qapomb noum zeyi. De vati wei e qepei qapomb zeyi eno xelti se teyeimbei tax.

A woulek wa xe xuk woy. Wei, a tax qapomb ti wou wa mamghalus wei xelti se teyeimbei qepei qapomb zeyi. A woulek bei wa nimkanzek on nayaka, ekom wang mi zeimaxoun a xe qayeeng dom seng mi ax a leing vun.

Tyek am bong xel wei xomek qekueing ama wei Sandang, wei xel mi neil embei xel Yudayeiw ekom xel ne se Yudayeiw, qe xel ne tyonyeingana. Tyek am bong xel nam me dev vaxend qatu wou wa vaxam me gyei lek mend bei a laleing vind wang.
Nambei wang mi zeimaxoun a xe petieing de ghe mi axe myavanei enden, tyek a gheiteyei wang veil bouk wei axeing wei embei nam lek tembuing sapa nei bei daxe xel wei mindei lek tembuing o.
Tyek a nak wou wang daing. Om wa Zeimaxoun vati wei wa xe yo, en kandek xelti se qou wa xe xouveing.

E wei xoklek nimaying eno tyek a balax e nambei mundeeng wei xomek vambuing wei a xe Anutu yo. Tyek se teyeimbei e nox me na veil no. Tyek a byex a xe Anutu lei lek e me beyeeng ngandoung wei a xe Anutu yo lei lek e is Yerusalem vako, wei lam xone veil tyoung gheyapu wei a xe Anutu yo, me tyek a byex leing vako lek e is ambei inyon.
E tiwei nenyalis toundei lek e yo, wong e ngo vati wei Laweeng Vambuing di neil wou xel kongrikesin o.”
Qayeeng ne la wou kongrikesin wei toundei eivek Laodisia yo
Woyom tambiy tiyon neil no, “Wa byex qayeeng tine na wou angela wei toundei eivek kongrikesin wei Laodisia yo.
Qayeeng beimambei ne eno inyei lam wou tiwei Zonghek o, de mi wo Anutu xe xuk la wou eivek de mi tul xoulek taxombouk, de e qes wei Anutu mema xuk sapa yo.
A woulek wa xe xuk woy, bei wa seng wo nityuweing o wa seng wo nivanei. A wou naleing bei wang bong ambei yuw on nge nityuweing o nivanei.
Ekom ma a bim a pesuv wang nam veil myang, en wang noux nayaka, wa se nivanei me wa se nityuweing,

wang neimbei, ‘A ne lulul ana, a mi qekuwou lulul ngenongakes om tyek a qou vati no me a se ma en lulul ti.’ Ekom wa seng woulek bei wang dei nilul ayang, teyeimbei xel a pyaw naleind en wang, me wang wo kanyo, me wa matekeing me wang toundei xeim dengeing.

Om am bo kwa tine wou wang bei wang bou ghol wei a ne wei xel sei eivek nenyex me e wo belin ne yo, en kandek wang bo lulul ana. De wang bou Teimb teleing me na byex, en kandek wa sevun xeim dengeing, me wou denzi wei wa toung lek mamghalus o, en kandek wa mam e gyeina yo.
Xel wei a laleing vind eno a luk nikanzek wou xel me na pepyawexe xel. Om wa laleim e mi qandi lek de wa pekwi xow.
Ay inye! A toungale wou qapomb mya me na leis memang lek. Wangwei xelti e ngo a vyang me natax qapomb, tyek a nak lalei me na gha is e, de e gya is ay.
Ena wou e wei mi xoklek nimaying o, tyek a zewexe lek e bei e mendei is ay lek a xe siaking, nambei kawei a xoklek nimaying me na dei is mang lek e xe siaking o.
E tiwei nenyalis toundei lek e yo, wong e ngo vati wei Laweeng Vambuing di neil wou xel kongrikesin o.”
